definitions: A cloud computing platform as a service (PaaS) that allows developers to create and deploy applications that integrate with Salesforce products.
The underlying technology and infrastructure provided by Salesforce for building, running, and managing custom applications and integrations.
examples: Many companies build their custom CRM solutions on the Salesforce Platform.
Developers leverage the Salesforce Platform to extend the functionality of their existing Salesforce instances.
The Salesforce Platform offers robust tools for application development and deployment.
